title: Rava bar Tachlifa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Eruvin 40a](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.40a.7) in Ravina’s time. Hyman calls this a scribal error, for Rava bar Tachlifa was one of Rav’s students. He says that undoubtedly it was written רב״א, that is Rav Acha bar Tachlifa, and so it is in Dikdukei Soferim.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Bavli names Rava bar Tachlifa addressing Ravina, as does [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3173&lang=en) when discussing this episode. Hyman argues that the name is a copying error and proposes Rav Acha bar Tachlifa, citing Dikdukei Soferim.
